data.one_liner: A SQLite abstraction library for Flutter inspired by Room.
data.what_it_does: Floor provides automatic mapping between in-memory objects and SQLite database rows while offering full control via SQL. It uses code generation to create typesafe databases, DAOs, and entities, supporting both Futures and Streams for reactive queries.
use_when: You want a Room-like ORM experience for SQLite in Flutter
You need typesafe database queries and reactive data streams
avoid_when: You do not know SQL or SQLite
You prefer a simple key-value store like SharedPreferences
strengths: Typesafe and reactive with Stream support
weaknesses: Requires understanding of SQL and SQLite
Relies on code generation via build_runner
data.setup_notes: Requires adding floor, floor_generator, and build_runner to pubspec.yaml, and running build_runner to generate code.

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer writing raw SQL without code generation and ORM boilerplate.

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a more feature-rich reactive SQLite library with fluent query building.

alternatives.name: sqlite3
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want direct low-level bindings to SQLite.
